title: Recommendations for the dynamic solvers in the solver manual
author: Claude-JG
description: The manual compares the dynamic solvers but does not say which to take. Decided: a section after the convergence and efficiency section, with the warning on the algebraic coordinates at small steps and how to repeat the study.
releaseNotes: The solver manual recommends a dynamic solver per kind of problem and warns of the growth of the error of the algebraic coordinates at very small steps.
